The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and the driver: both of you agree on the arithmetic, and so do I, so this is a short case on the money and a longer one on the defences. THE FINDING. The measurement that governs is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02858: 27.69 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off, against the booked optimal route of 21.3 km on EV-TRIP-02858 (POL-RD-01 says the trace figure governs over the rounded 27.7 km copy on the trip record). That is 6.39 km and 30.0% over. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (not more than 50%, not more than 8.0 km), and the trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 218 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. THE MONEY. The fare model on EV-FARE-02858 is METERED, so POL-RD-02 applies. Taking the surge multiplier from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on that same artifact (1.0, read from nowhere else): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.3 + 0.28 x 28.8) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 28.639. charged_total was 35.52. Refund = 35.52 - 28.639 = 6.881, above the 0.50 de minimis and 19.4% of the charge — far below the 90% that would make it a full refund — so the payable amount, rounded up to the nearest 0.05, is 6.90. Nothing is added on top: there are no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09(1) forbids any add-on and POL-RD-09(4) has no phantom line to correct. The rider asked for 6.90 rather than the 9.00 on the dispute form, and 6.90 is the whole of the remedy; the claim for the balance is not supported by any clause. THE DRIVER'S DEFENCES. The chat log EV-CHAT-02858 is empty (0 messages), so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to work with and no waypoint_hint to test; the trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The only explanation offered is 'Followed navigation'. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02858-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 (an assertion that cites no artifact discharges nothing). Because no advisory was cited by the driver, POL-RD-13(1) applies: an uncited traffic assertion is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, so the case is ruled and not escalated, and POL-RD-13(2) leaves the deviation standing at the measured figure. THE IDENTIFIER POINT (the driver's two alternative arguments). I have checked it. EV-FARE-02858 is filed under this trip's identifier TRP-02858; its line is charged at 09:17:49, 25 seconds after this trip's ended_at of 09:17:24, for exactly the 35.52 in dispute, and its charged distance and time (27.7 km, 36.2 min) match the trip record. The string 'TRP-02758' inside its payload is contradicted by the rest of that same artifact. The three artifacts do carry matching trip identifiers, so the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is discharged and POL-RD-10(2) does not fire. I record the inconsistency here rather than in the referrals list: no clause produces a referral for it, and the platform should correct the ledger payload so the artifact reconciling to this trip reads TRP-02858 throughout. For completeness, no other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trace is unimpaired (10(3)), the money is nowhere near the 10(6) ceiling, the timestamps cohere (10(4)), and every charge line has a counterpart in the trace and trip record (10(8)). REPEAT-DEVIATION UPLIFT AND CONDUCT REFERRAL. None is available. The deviation is not material, so the POL-RD-06 check is not even triggered, and on its own test the driver's trailing-90-day figures on EV-DPROF-02858 (1 deviation flag, 309 completed trips) fall far below both the 3-flag and the 0.05-ratio thresholds. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and has not been used. OUTCOME AND NEXT STEPS. The rider is refunded 6.90; the driver is owed nothing — the ledger billed 27.7 km against a trace of 27.69 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall under POL-RD-04. The confidence cap is set by the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02858, EV-TRIP-02858 and EV-FARE-02858, all at weight 1.0); the missing advisory carries no fact and does not cap it. The monetary effect (6.90) is below the 8.00 execution threshold, so it is released on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The deviation is established on the field that governs. The GPS polyline between the recorded pickup event and the recorded drop-off event measures 27.69 km (trace_distance_km) against a booked optimal of 21.3 km, an excess of 6.39 km — 30.0% of optimal. That clears the 20% limb and clears the 0.8 km limb, so both establishment tests of POL-RD-01 pass and the deviation is ESTABLISHED. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing measurement and forbids citing the rounded 27.7 km on the trip record in its place; the two straddle nothing here, but the 27.69 km figure is the one the ruling must use.

evidence EV-GPS-02858, EV-TRIP-02858 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so the measured excess stands and no independent corroboration is required. EV-GPS-02858 carries 218 fixes at a 10 second sample interval with 100.0% coverage and no gap at all between consecutive fixes (max_gap_sec 0.0, gaps list empty). None of limbs (a), (b) or (c) of POL-RD-07 fires: there is no gap above 90 seconds, no straight-line jump above 500 m and no sampling interval above 30 seconds. POL-RD-10(3) is therefore not engaged and the trace alone carries the excess.

evidence EV-GPS-02858 · clauses POL-RD-07, POL-RD-10

kept The rider's initial burden is discharged under POL-RD-08. The excess of 6.39 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace, so limb (b) is satisfied and the burden shifts to the driver. That payload identifier does not match the TRP-02858 on EV-TRIP-02858 and EV-GPS-02858. The mismatch is a matter of record, not of argument, and on a rider-filed dispute a failure of the claimant's burden leaves the CHARGED status and the zero refund_issued_sgd on EV-FARE-02858 exactly as they stand under POL-GEN-03.

evidence EV-FARE-02858, EV-TRIP-02858, EV-GPS-02858 · clauses POL-RD-08, POL-GEN-03

kept In the alternative, that same mismatch is a mandatory escalation and no monetary outcome should issue. That result protects the driver's settled position on this trip while a human reviewer resolves which identifier governs.

To the rider and the driver: both of you agree on the arithmetic, and so do I, so this is a short case on the money and a longer one on the defences. THE FINDING. The measurement that governs is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02858: 27.69 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off, against the booked optimal route of 21.3 km on EV-TRIP-02858 (POL-RD-01 says the trace figure governs over the rounded 27.7 km copy on the trip record). That is 6.39 km and 30.0% over. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (not more than 50%, not more than 8.0 km), and the trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 218 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. THE MONEY. The fare model on EV-FARE-02858 is METERED, so POL-RD-02 applies. Taking the surge multiplier from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on that same artifact (1.0, read from nowhere else): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.3 + 0.28 x 28.8) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 28.639. charged_total was 35.52. Refund = 35.52 - 28.639 = 6.881, above the 0.50 de minimis and 19.4% of the charge — far below the 90% that would make it a full refund — so the payable amount, rounded up to the nearest 0.05, is 6.90. Nothing is added on top: there are no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09(1) forbids any add-on and POL-RD-09(4) has no phantom line to correct. The rider asked for 6.90 rather than the 9.00 on the dispute form, and 6.90 is the whole of the remedy; the claim for the balance is not supported by any clause. THE DRIVER'S DEFENCES. The chat log EV-CHAT-02858 is empty (0 messages), so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to work with and no waypoint_hint to test; the trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The only explanation offered is 'Followed navigation'. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02858-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 (an assertion that cites no artifact discharges nothing). Because no advisory was cited by the driver, POL-RD-13(1) applies: an uncited traffic assertion is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, so the case is ruled and not escalated, and POL-RD-13(2) leaves the deviation standing at the measured figure. THE IDENTIFIER POINT (the driver's two alternative arguments). I have checked it. EV-FARE-02858 is filed under this trip's identifier TRP-02858; its line is charged at 09:17:49, 25 seconds after this trip's ended_at of 09:17:24, for exactly the 35.52 in dispute, and its charged distance and time (27.7 km, 36.2 min) match the trip record. The string 'TRP-02758' inside its payload is contradicted by the rest of that same artifact. The three artifacts do carry matching trip identifiers, so the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is discharged and POL-RD-10(2) does not fire. I record the inconsistency here rather than in the referrals list: no clause produces a referral for it, and the platform should correct the ledger payload so the artifact reconciling to this trip reads TRP-02858 throughout. For completeness, no other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trace is unimpaired (10(3)), the money is nowhere near the 10(6) ceiling, the timestamps cohere (10(4)), and every charge line has a counterpart in the trace and trip record (10(8)). REPEAT-DEVIATION UPLIFT AND CONDUCT REFERRAL. None is available. The deviation is not material, so the POL-RD-06 check is not even triggered, and on its own test the driver's trailing-90-day figures on EV-DPROF-02858 (1 deviation flag, 309 completed trips) fall far below both the 3-flag and the 0.05-ratio thresholds. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and has not been used. OUTCOME AND NEXT STEPS. The rider is refunded 6.90; the driver is owed nothing — the ledger billed 27.7 km against a trace of 27.69 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall under POL-RD-04. The confidence cap is set by the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02858, EV-TRIP-02858 and EV-FARE-02858, all at weight 1.0); the missing advisory carries no fact and does not cap it. The monetary effect (6.90) is below the 8.00 execution threshold, so it is released on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

POL-RD-10(2) directs that no final ruling be issued where the trip identifiers on the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown do not all match, and under POL-GEN-03 an escalation is terminal: it replaces the ruling, no refund or compensation issues, and the disputed amount is held. Both parties: this ruling returns SGD 6.90 of the SGD 35.52 charged and leaves the remainder of the charge in place. THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED.
